description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.name: Candelabra of Tawnos
uses.cardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater
